transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you're aware, Weld Cell 4 went down this morning after a coolant-system alarm activated during the 480 chassis bracket run. Visually, the cell looks normal with no obvious weld defects, but that alarm tripped for a reason. Before I can authorize a restart, I need to walk through this properly with both quality and maintenance per our restart procedure. So let's get started — I need to understand what the coolant alarm is telling us, what maintenance has found so far, and what quality needs to see before we run any more brackets. Who wants to go first?

transcript.text: I need to share some critical findings before we go further. Per our quality containment rule, we are required to hold exactly 240 brackets from that production window and perform destructive validation on exactly 12 brackets after the cell is corrected. I completed this review this morning, but I have not yet entered the results in the batch record. I'm flagging this now so it's on the table before we discuss restart.
